title: Memory
subtitle: Control automatic memory generation, usage, and consolidation scope.
scopeNotice: These settings, session candidates, and memory files belong to the host currently running OpenBitFun. Another device or peer host may have different memory data and settings.

basic.title: Basics
basic.description: Control whether new memories are generated and whether consolidated memories are used in sessions.

models.title: Models
models.description: Choose the models used to extract and consolidate memories.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.description: Tune memory extraction and consolidation limits. These settings are optional.

extraction.title: Extraction
extraction.description: Control which completed sessions are eligible for memory extraction.

consolidation.title: Consolidation
consolidation.description: Control how extracted results are prepared before becoming long-term memory.

status.title: Memory status
status.description: This describes the memory store of the device running OpenBitFun. Memory is not part of the workspace, so these numbers do not move with a remote workspace.

fields.memoryRootHint: Host-local folder that holds the memory files.
fields.storedOutputsHint: Extracted results currently kept in the memory store.
fields.pendingPromotionHint: Stored memories that no consolidation pass has merged yet.
fields.phase2NeverRun: No consolidation pass has run yet.
fields.memoryIndexHint: Size of the long-term memory index file.
fields.memorySummaryHint: Size of the summary file injected into sessions.
fields.rolloutSummariesHint: Per-session extraction files in the memory folder.

failed.title: Sessions that failed extraction
failed.description: These sessions could not be extracted. They stay listed until extraction succeeds, their retry budget is restored, or the failure is older than the failure report window. Clearing the failure records lets them be retried on the next memory run.
failed.clearConfirm: This deletes the failure records of the listed sessions on the current execution host. Extracted memories are kept, and clearing the failure bookkeeping lets these sessions be retried on the next memory run.
failed.clearFailed: Failed to clear failed extraction records

messages.pipelineDisabled: Automatic memory generation is disabled, so nothing was started
messages.startFailed: Failed to start the memory pipeline
messages.pollTimedOut: The pipeline is still running after 10 minutes, so status refresh stopped. Reopen this page to refresh again.

memoryEnabled.label: Memory
memoryEnabled.description: When enabled, memories are generated automatically and used in sessions.

memoryActions.label: Memory actions
memoryActions.description: Open the memory folder, restore default settings, or permanently clear memory data on the current execution host.

generateMemories.label: Generate memories automatically
generateMemories.description: Extract and consolidate reusable memory from completed local sessions in the background.

useMemories.label: Use memories in sessions
useMemories.description: New sessions can read the consolidated memory summary as context.

generateForBtwSessions.label: Generate memories from BTW sessions
generateForBtwSessions.description: Allow BTW sessions to contribute to global memory.

externalContextPolicy.label: External context handling
externalContextPolicy.description: Choose how memory extraction handles sessions that used web search, web page reading, or similar tools.

minRolloutIdleHours.label: Minimum idle time
minRolloutIdleHours.description: How long a completed session must sit idle before extraction.

maxRolloutAgeDays.label: Maximum session age
maxRolloutAgeDays.description: Sessions older than this many days are no longer considered for extraction. This cannot exceed candidate retention.

maxRolloutsPerStartup.label: Extraction limit per run
maxRolloutsPerStartup.description: Maximum number of sessions claimed for memory extraction each time the memory task starts.

maxRolloutsScanLimit.label: Scan limit per run
maxRolloutsScanLimit.description: Maximum number of completed sessions checked while looking for extraction candidates.

phase1MaxConcurrency.label: Extraction concurrency
phase1MaxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of eligible sessions extracted at the same time.

extractModel.label: Extraction model
extractModel.description: Model used to distill candidate memories from session transcripts.

maxRawMemories.label: Consolidation candidate limit
maxRawMemories.description: Maximum extracted results used in each long-term memory consolidation pass.

maxUnusedDays.label: Candidate retention
maxUnusedDays.description: Unused extracted results older than this many days are permanently deleted, and the memory content consolidated from them is removed from MEMORY.md at the next consolidation. This must be at least the maximum session age.

consolidationModel.label: Consolidation model
consolidationModel.description: Model used to merge candidates and update long-term memory files.

actions.resetSettingsConfirm: This restores the memory switches, models, and advanced parameters on the current execution host to their defaults. Existing memory data is not deleted.
actions.resetMemoryConfirm: This permanently deletes all memory data and memory workspace files on the current execution host. This cannot be undone.

messages.loadFailedLocked: Memory settings could not be read. This page is locked to avoid overwriting the configuration on the current execution host.
messages.rolloutAgeExceedsRetention: Maximum session age cannot exceed candidate retention
